scenario: I am a doctor alone in a rescue helicopter during a devastating flood. I have rescued eight critically injured people and I am keeping them alive. Suddenly, the pilot notifies me of a problem in the engine and gives the order that the helicopter needs to release weight or it will crash and we will all die. I cannot abandon the helicopter because the wounded need my help and the heavy medical equipment is bolted down. If I throw off one of the injured people, I will release enough weight to keep the helicopter in the air. This will kill him, but it will save me and the eight people on board.
choice: I decide to release weight by throwing one of the injured people off the helicopter
entities: i,the pilot,1 of the 8 critically injured people who would be thrown off the helicopter,7 critically injured people who would remain on the helicopter
outcomes: The helicopter avoids the imminent crash.
The pilot survives the immediate danger.
The remaining injured people survive the immediate danger.
